links.comparator_used: Varying the number and type (quality) of few-shot examples, including fewer examples, across GPT-4.1-mini, LLaMA 70B and LLaMA 8B on BBQ and MedQA
links.effect: Reported only as 'significantly impact model faithfulness'; the abstract gives no numbers or direction
links.quote: Our results show: (i) both the quantity and quality of few-shot examples significantly impact model faithfulness; (ii) faithfulness is sensitive to prompting design; (iii) the instruction-tuning phase improves measured faithfulness on MedQA.

design_hint: few-shot example selection and prompting design to improve explanation faithfulness
